author: The Infographics Show
description:
The ads on your phone aren’t just trying to sell you something. The same tracking systems behind them can also reveal where you sleep, work, worship, shop, travel, and law enforcement agencies can buy access to that information.

This video explores how advertising data became a powerful surveillance tool. Services like Fog Reveal allow investigators to search location histories gathered from ordinary apps, often without contacting Apple, Google, or your phone carrier. Instead, the data flows through advertising SDKs, brokers, and real-time bidding systems before ending up in databases that can track hundreds of millions of devices. We examine the legal loopholes that make this possible, why supposedly anonymous location data can often be traced back to a real person, and how innocent people can be swept into investigations simply because their phones appeared near the wrong place at the wrong time.

Your smartphone isn’t only showing you ads. It may also be building a permanent map o
title: Ads You See Online Are Now Police Surveillance

description:
The stock market is hitting all-time highs while millions of Americans feel poorer every month. That contradiction makes more sense once you realize the stock market and the real economy are no longer measuring the same thing.

This video explores why enormous amounts of global capital are flooding into U.S. stocks even as households struggle with higher prices, expensive housing, and declining purchasing power. When investors lose confidence in other markets, America becomes a financial safe haven, and much of that money flows into a handful of companies like Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Tesla, and Alphabet. At the same time, massive government debt and rising interest costs are putting increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve and Treasury. Policies designed to keep liquidity flowing and borrowing costs manageable can push asset prices higher while slowly weakening the value of the dollar.

title: If Economy is Failing... How Are Stock at ALL TIME HIGH
